name: D&D Beyond
author: Brian Starke
description: Character sheets from your D&D Beyond account in the bar: stats, skills, spells, features, and inventory in a tabbed card.

barWidget.description: Pick a character from your D&D Beyond account and browse its sheet in tabs: main stats, skills, spells, features, and inventory.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the open card re-fetches the selected character sheet.

schema.label: Default tab
schema.description: The tab shown when the card opens.

schema.label: Show HP in bar
schema.description: Show current/max hit points next to the dice glyph in the bar.

schema.label: Color HP by health
schema.description: Tint the bar HP numbers green above 75%, yellow between, red below 25%.

schema.label: Show character name in bar
schema.description: Show the selected character's name in the bar next to the dice glyph.

schema.label: Additional character IDs
schema.description: Comma-separated character IDs (from the dndbeyond.com/characters/<id> URL) to add to the picker, e.g. shared or private characters the account list misses.
